sentences.text:
Coram: - Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Ambuj Nath
-----
 For Petitioner : M/s. Md. Ayub Ansari, Advocate
 For the State : M/s. Lily Sahay, A.P.P
 ---
 02/21.07.2023 Heard the Parties.

Petitioner has been made an accused in connection with S.T. Case No. 115/2022, arising out of Jugsalai P.S. Case No. 154/2021, registered under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the Court of learned Additional Sessions Judge-IV, Jamshedpur.
Bail application of the petitioner was twice rejected earlier by this court.
While rejecting his bail application vide B.A. No. 9722/2022 by order dated 09.12.2022, liberty was given to the petitioner to renew his prayer for bail after 6 months.
It is alleged that the petitioner had established physical relationship with the prosecutrix and immediately thereafter he refused to marry her.
From the impugned order, it appears that only one witness has been examined till today.
It was submitted that charge was framed in this case on 05.05.2022, but the prosecutrix has not been examined till date.
It was further submitted that the petitioner is in custody since 29.11.2021.

Regard being had to the facts and circumstance of the case, the petitioner named above, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 20,000/- (Twenty Thousand only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of Additional Sessions Judge-IV, Jamshedpur in connection S.T. Case No. 115/2022, arising out of Jugsalai P.S. Case No. 154/2021.
